pilot_exclusion: S001R02 was already inspected and is excluded from confirmatory inference.

null_model.type: independent channel-wise circular shift within the exact 2048-sample tail window
null_model.finite_policy: replace non-finite tail samples with 0.0 before shifting
null_model.purpose: destroy cross-channel temporal alignment while preserving each channel's cyclic temporal ordering and amplitude samples; run the unchanged operator afterward

group_inference.primary_count: number of 10 subjects with primary empirical p <= 0.05
group_inference.test: one-sided exact binomial tail with n=10 and p=0.05

parity_gate.comparison: every observed scale metric and every observed pair metric for every subject

guardrails: No operator parameter, subject, endpoint, null rule, surrogate count, direction, threshold or tolerance may change after results are observed.
This tests reproducibility relative to one preregistered null, not universality or physical-law status.
Q is a coupling-loss proxy and chi_dyn is a VAR(1) spectral-radius coordinate.
Sensor-space research output only; no diagnostic, biomarker, source-localization or causal claim.
